matches.title: dev-mode-guard: metadata check only, drop the LTO release build
matches.description:
Goal: The required `dev-mode-guard` CI job keeps its name and real check but stops doing a full LTO release build whose log nobody reads.

Non-goals: Renaming or removing the required check; changing the release profile.

Governing spec: docs/scope.md T8 row (delete code without a current user; behavior tests tied to docs/invariants.md; resource tests; llvmpipe recipe; strip pre-reset refs) and 'Working rules' (prefer deleting over generalizing; tests guard behavior a user would notice, not internal structure); docs/vision.md; docs/invariants.md; CLAUDE.md Rules; AGENTS.md (just recipes).

T7 boundary: do not edit crates/tze_hud_projection/**, crates/tze_hud_runtime/src/portal_projection_driver.rs, crates/tze_hud_runtime/src/windowed/portal.rs, crates/tze_hud_input/src/{composer_draft,portal_resize}.rs, crates/tze_hud_config/src/portal_tokens.rs, crates/tze_hud_mcp/src/portal_op.rs or tests/integration/text_stream_portal_*.rs; keep every pub item those files import until T7 (epic hud-lirh2) lands.

Line refs are at windows-release-pipeline@44d355ef (same content as main@1eb8f7cb); re-grep symbols before editing. The planning survey is not persisted; this bead is self-contained.
matches.design:
Files:
- .github/workflows/ci.yml:446-530 (job), :454 (comment cites non-existent test `dev_mode_not_active_in_release`), :483 (`cargo build --workspace --release` with lto=true, codegen-units=1), :487-528 (inline cargo-metadata Python)
- scripts/ci/check_dev_mode_defaults.py (the same check)
- justfile `dev-mode-guard` (:100-103 / :109)

Evidence:
The real check is the cargo-metadata Python at ci.yml:487-528, which duplicates scripts/ci/check_dev_mode_defaults.py. windows.yml already does a real release build.

Approach:
Keep `name:` unchanged (required check). Steps become: checkout; `cargo metadata --no-deps --format-version 1 | python3 scripts/ci/check_dev_mode_defaults.py`. Drop protoc install, toolchain cache and the build. Fix the comment. Make the justfile recipe run the same command.

Tests:
Unchanged.

Expected delta: about -75 YAML lines; removes the longest per-PR job

Every test named in docs/invariants.md is kept, or moved/renamed with docs/invariants.md updated in the same PR. Local builds on this host need `PROTOC=$HOME/.local/protoc/bin/protoc` (/usr/bin/protoc 3.12 fails on types.proto).
matches.acceptance_criteria:
1. `cargo fmt --all --check` is clean.
2. `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings` is clean.
3. `just dev-mode-guard` passes locally and fails when a crate's default features include dev-mode (temporarily edit one Cargo.toml to prove it, then revert).
4. `grep -n 'cargo build --workspace --release\|dev_mode_not_active_in_release' .github/workflows/ci.yml` prints nothing; the job `name:` is unchanged.
5. `python3 -c "import yaml,sys; yaml.safe_load(open('.github/workflows/ci.yml'))"` succeeds.
6. Every test named in docs/invariants.md still exists (grep each name) or docs/invariants.md was updated in the same PR.
7. `just ci` is green once before handoff.

matches.title: Reconcile spec-to-code (gen-2) for T8.0: Enablers (GPU recipe, CI parity, test-file splits)
matches.description: Gen-2 reconciliation of epic hud-bstmy.1 after gen-1 (hud-bstmy.1.6) gaps are fixed. Re-check: dev-mode guard against mutated metadata cases; widget_transition and other GPU suites go through the shared serialization helper; every GPU-building recipe pins llvmpipe; docs no longer say GPU tests are excluded from just ci; how hud-bstmy.8.6 (required-check ruleset) was resolved. Same mindset as gen-1: falsify, enumerate paths, audit instruments.
matches.design:
Outcome and authority: Perform a READ-ONLY gen-2 spec-to-code reconciliation of T8.0 epic hud-bstmy.1. Deliver an exact-commit checklist and a coordinator handoff establishing which original enabler requirements and gen-1 corrections are implemented, partial, missing, or deviating. Falsify the codebase's coverage claims; sibling closure and green tests alone are not proof. Governing sources are docs/scope.md T8 and Working rules, docs/vision.md (test volume is not confidence; Linux is headless CI), docs/invariants.md, AGENTS.md's local harness/GPU contracts, the epic, original children hud-bstmy.1.1-.1.5, gen-1 hud-bstmy.1.6, corrections hud-bstmy.1.7-.1.10, and any later enabler children such as hud-bstmy.1.12. All original criteria remain audit obligations. The broader T8 resource tests/code diet/reference removal belong to their existing sibling epics; record their relationship without implementing or absorbing them into this enabler audit.

Non-goals: No Rust, Python, workflow, recipe, manifest, spec, or product documentation edits; no new tests, production serialization policy, CI/ruleset changes, issue creation/update/close/dependency mutation, or owner decision. The coordinator owns all Beads lifecycle and materializes follow-ups. Do not restore pre-reset RFC/OpenSpec/doctrine requirements. Do not wait for unanswered needs-human escalations whose documented default is status quo.

Bootstrap and sequencing: Work in the assigned isolated worktree and expected agent branch; verify actual shell cwd, canonical common Git directory, and absence of repository-identity Git environment overrides. Record HEAD before reading or running checks; re-grep sources because old line numbers are historical. Read AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md, then compact current parent/sibling fields and dependency state. hud-bstmy.1.7-.1.10 are existing prerequisites; a closed child is an evidence lead, not a coverage verdict. If .1.12 is still open, report the residual serialization finding against that existing bead and allow the coordinator to wire/sequence it; never create a duplicate or silently declare full coverage.

Owned audit map and required rows:
A. GPU local signal (.1.1, .1.8, and later .1.12): inspect justfile's actual ICD discovery and every GPU-building recipe, compositor renderer/tests/mod.rs, renderer/tests/surface.rs, compositor tests/common/mod.rs and every compositor test binary, runtime src/test_support.rs, runtime tests/pixel_helpers.rs, present_ack.rs, tests/integration, examples/vertical_slice, and canonical app boot tests. Enumerate every device/runtime constructor and every indirect helper or macro caller, including pre-existing sites. Verify one shared async serialization gate per multi-test binary, its protected operation and lifetime, and any single-GPU-test exception by proving no competing creation path exists in that binary. Distinguish construction-only helpers from runtime-lib guards held across an entire scenario, and per-process locks from cross-process coordination. Do not assume HEADLESS_FORCE_SOFTWARE excludes a hardware Vulkan ICD. Enumerate every GPU recipe, including test, test-gpu, test-integration, both token-footprint runs, production-boot and canonical-app-boot, plus newly discovered recipes. Compare their environment and target/feature flags against CI. ICD discovery must follow justfile's actual lvp selection, supporting both lvp_icd.x86_64.json and Mesa 25's lvp_icd.json; dry-runs in this baseline select lvp_icd.json.
B. Local/CI parity (.1.2, .1.9, .1.10): inspect every run step in .github/workflows/ci.yml and just --dry-run ci. Map validation commands/targets/features/environment to recipes; explicitly classify platform provisioning, artifact upload, informational duplicate pixel-readback, and weekly performance exclusions rather than pretending they are local behavior gates. Verify integration uses all test targets, Python uses pytest plus scripts/ci unittest discovery, deterministic token-footprint calibration/checks are reachable, and all six formerly orphaned Python files are exercised or removed together with dead subjects: test_check_constrained_envelope, test_check_windows_perf_budgets, test_constrained_envelope_runner, test_report_telemetry_trend, test_select_constrained_cpu_pair, test_windowed_overlay_perf_script. Check Windows-GNU clippy, cargo-deny, and the pwsh overlay harness recipe paths and their explicit SKIPPED behavior. Diff README.md, AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, justfile comments and CI comments against commands. GPU compositor tests and runtime pixel_readback must be described as included in just test/just ci and blocking test-unit through feature unification; the dedicated informational CI pixel-readback job is a duplicate. Distinguish informational, blocking workflow, and owner-managed required-check status.
C. Release dev-mode exclusion (.1.3, .1.7): read scripts/ci/check_dev_mode_defaults.py, all workspace Cargo.toml feature/dependency declarations and metadata package/target inventory, and scripts/ci/test_check_dev_mode_defaults.py. Verify the shipped tze_hud_app closure and every shippable workspace package are checked rather than a hardcoded three-package list. Enumerate normal/build edges, dev-edge exclusion, defaults/default-features=false, aliases, optional dependency activation, forwarded/weak feature references, cycles, repeated dependency entries of different kinds/targets, and package/target/third-party assumptions. Audit the instrument's roots and eligibility predicates for blind spots. Run clean real metadata through the exact command shared by just and CI, and execute existing fixture tests for protocol default dev-mode, app-to-runtime feature activation, default feature indirection, forwarded dependency activation, packages outside the app closure, inactive optionals, repeated target/build-kind entries, clean repeated edges and missing shipped package. Any scratch mutated-metadata counterexample stays outside tracked code and restores no files because manifests are never edited. Confirm the redundant cargo build --workspace --release and obsolete dev_mode_not_active_in_release reference are absent from ci.yml, while the required job display name stays unchanged and windows.yml still owns the actual release build.
D. Pure splits and invariant preservation (.1.4, .1.5): inspect compositor renderer/tests/ and protocol session_server/tests/ module wiring, shared helpers, topic files, absence of their old monolithic tests.rs files, and compositor files' original <=6500-line split criterion. Use the delivered PR/merge history to verify the split commits preserved all test bodies/assertions and before/after counts (original 275 compositor and 135 protocol tests); explain later authorized edits separately rather than treating today's counts as split-era counts. Verify every currently named docs/invariants.md test exists in its owning crate and remains a behavior-executing gate with the documented contract. Inspect relevant implementing code and tests; a name grep only establishes retention. Preserve the T7 boundary and the shared-helper/module paths communicated by the split work.
E. Required-check escalation hud-bstmy.8.6: read current description, acceptance and owner notes, including the .1.9 correction that pixel_readback already blocks in test-unit. Unanswered means option C/status quo: no required-check or workflow changes, and no dependency on an owner response. If an explicit answer exists, include the resulting implementation bead and actual delivered follow-up in the matrix, verify the stated ruleset coordination through read-only evidence, and report unresolved coordination to the coordinator. Never infer owner approval from elapsed time or a proposed option.

Audit method: For every universal or negative claim, save the complete searched surface and constructor/recipe/package/test inventory, then assess every entry. Compare repeated surfaces side by side for filtering, defaults, scope, target selection and failure handling. Audit guard instruments themselves: feature traversal, target/package exclusions, GPU skip/canary behavior, discovery roots, unittest enumeration and every source-scan regex/glob/root used as evidence. Each scenario needs one adequate gate species: an existing behavior-executing test or the designated structural scan/type/lint rule. Multiple test files may be part of that species; do not propose parallel source-grep tests for behavior already executed. A passing but blind guard is a gap in that guard, not justification for another redundant test.

Behavior and verification matrix: Happy path is complete traced coverage plus clean real metadata and executed representative GPU/CI gates. Invalid metadata or missing shipped package must fail the guard, while legitimate dev-only/test-only and inactive optional edges must retain the documented behavior. Concurrency evidence covers all in-process initialization sites and guard release on failure; do not equate software-adapter selection with serialization. Missing tools, adapter, ICD, skipped tests, timeouts and failed commands are recorded as unverified/failed, never implemented-by-green-skip. Check the recipe's selected ICD before declaring an environment limitation; do not inspect only the old filename. Replay/idempotence means reruns on the same SHA preserve classification and token-footprint measurements, with no new mutation or duplicate gap candidates. Concurrent main changes require a fresh source re-grep and a new evidence SHA; mixed-SHA evidence is invalid. Cancellation leaves an incomplete report whose unexecuted commands are explicit. Rollback and persistent-schema migration are not applicable because this audit changes no production or stored state. Historical split compatibility and named invariant retention remain applicable.

Verification plan: At minimum run just dev-mode-guard and python3 -m unittest discover -s scripts/ci -p test_check_dev_mode_defaults.py; record just --dry-run ci and each GPU recipe, verify CI YAML parses, and inspect all relevant existing test bodies and production implementing paths. Re-run the original local GPU proof through just test-gpu twice, with actual execution, TZE_HUD_REQUIRE_GPU=1 and per-suite 900-second bounds; record compilation separately. Execute just test-integration, just test-python and just token-footprint where this baseline's actual capabilities permit. Run just ci once for the integrated parity proof; its fmt/clippy/check/test/boot contracts remain obligations, and any tool-gated SKIP is explicitly an evidence limitation. Prefer existing valid exact-SHA evidence over blindly re-running unrelated expensive suites, but never substitute old-commit evidence for a changed surface. Do not run bare hardware-ICD compositor tests. Audit creates zero tests and changes zero code lines.

Documentation impact: No direct documentation/spec amendment is authorized in this READ-ONLY bead. The report must include file:line proposals for any stale README/AGENTS/CLAUDE/justfile/CI/invariants statements, with the governing source and exact discrepancy. Investigation notes belong in the coordinator handoff or subsequent PR description, not new docs investigation files, per docs/scope.md Working rules. A spec change or invariant reduction requires the owner's explicit authority and is not a reconciliation fix.

Deliverable and gap protocol: Return the exact SHA, original requirement -> implementing bead -> code file:line -> gate species -> executed command/result -> classification matrix, complete universal inventories, instrument findings, verification limitations, proposed documentation corrections and a concise close-summary candidate. For every partial/missing/deviating requirement return Discovered-Follow-Ups-JSON entries containing a dedupe key, title, issue type/priority/complexity, parent hud-bstmy.1, proposed blockers and existing overlapping bead/PR IDs, outcome/non-goals, exact current spec link, implementation surface and trust boundary, cold-start design/failure matrix, measurable acceptance evidence, nearest existing test to extend or reason no adequate gate exists, gate species and expected net test delta. matches.title: Add closure-grade CI workflow (GitHub Actions)
matches.description:
The repository has no .github/workflows/ directory. There are no automated CI gates preventing regression on v1 closure items.

Work required:
1. Create .github/workflows/ci.yml with the following jobs:
   a. check: cargo check --workspace (fast fail)
   b. test-unit: cargo test --workspace --all-targets --exclude integration (unit + crate tests)
   c. test-integration: cargo test -p integration --test trace_regression (if feasible without GPU)
   d. clippy: cargo clippy --workspace -- -D warnings
   e. fmt: cargo fmt --check
2. Add a production-config-boot test target:
   - cargo test -p vertical_slice --test production_boot (or similar) that boots the runtime with the committed production config and verifies startup succeeds
3. Add a vocabulary lint job:
   - Run the canonical vocabulary check script from the vocabulary bead
   - Fail CI if stale names found
4. Add a dev-mode-in-production check:
   - cargo build --workspace --release 2>&1 | grep -v 'dev-mode' to verify dev-mode feature is not accidentally enabled in release builds
   - Or: a test that asserts HeadlessConfig::default() is not available without dev-mode feature
5. Optionally: a windowed smoke job (documented as manual/gated if CI environment lacks GPU)
6. Add a capability revocation scenario test target (depends on the revocation bead landing)

Acceptance:
- .github/workflows/ci.yml exists and runs on push/PR to main.
- CI covers: check, test, clippy, fmt, production-config-boot, vocabulary lint, dev-mode guard.
- Documented gated job for windowed/GPU tests if not feasible in CI.
